answer: LIST st, ci, zp, sa FROM Satscore has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip zp AND ALSO has SchoolState sa AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t WHERE t <> 0 ORDERED WITH g / t ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolLongitude lo AND ALSO OPTIONALLY has SchoolGSoffered g ORDERED WITH abs(lo) DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, dt FROM Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType dt AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a WHERE k - a > (THE AVERAGE k2 IN Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] [has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2) - (THE AVERAGE a3 IN Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] [has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k3] has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a3)
LIST n FROM Frpm has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmPercentEligibleFreeK12 p AND ALSO has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE p > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST d, c FROM School e [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty d AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY d AS c WHERE (d = 'San Diego' OR d = 'Santa Barbara') ORDERED WITH c DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
